65050-brief-for-the-higher-education-of-.creator: Unknown

arxiv-1904-01229.title: Microscopic study of K-Selection Rule Violation in 182 W K=10 + Isomer Decay
arxiv-1904-01229.creator: C. R. Praharaj*, Swagatika Bhoi*, Z. Naik, S. K. Ghorui, S. K. Patra
arxiv-1904-01229.description: Abstract In this paper we study the microscopic mechanism for the retarded decay of K-isomers to lower K bands. We do angular momentum projection from suitable intrinsic states. The retardation arises from poor overlap between the low K and high K bands in the integral over Euler angles.

arxiv-2102-05536.title: Slicing the hypercube is not easy
arxiv-2102-05536.creator: Gal Yehuda, Amir Yehudayoff
arxiv-2102-05536.description: Abstract . We prove that at least Ω ⁡ ( n 0.51 ) \Omega(n^{0.51}) hyperplanes are needed to slice all edges of the n n -dimensional hypercube. We provide a couple of applications: lower bounds on the computational complexity of parity, and a lower bound on the cover number of the hypercube by skew hyperplanes. 1.

arxiv-2105-04125.title: Norm rigidity for arithmetic and profinite groups
arxiv-2105-04125.creator: Leonid Polterovich, Yehuda Shalom, Zvi Shem-Tov
arxiv-2105-04125.description: Abstract Let A A be a commutative ring, and assume every non-trivial ideal of A A has finite-index. We show that if SL n ​ ( A ) {\rm{SL}}_{n}(A) has bounded elementary generation then every conjugation-invariant norm on it is either discrete or precompact.

arxiv-2110-06969.title: Full-shape cosmology analysis of SDSS-III BOSS galaxy power spectrum using emulator-based halo model: a 5 % 5\% determination of σ 8 \sigma_{8} Preprint: IPMU21-0058
arxiv-2110-06969.creator: Yosuke Kobayashi 1,2, Takahiro Nishimichi 3,2, Masahiro Takada 2, Hironao Miyatake 4,2
arxiv-2110-06969.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yosuke Kobayashi 1,2, Takahiro Nishimichi 3,2, Masahiro Takada 2, Hironao Miyatake 4,2. We present the results obtained from the full-shape cosmology analysis of the redshift-space power spectra for 4 galaxy samples of the SDSS-III BOSS DR12 galaxy catalog over 0.2 < z < 0.75 0.2<z<0.75 . For the theoretical template, we use an emulator that was built from an ensemble set of N N -body simulations, which enables fast and accurate computation of the redshift-space power spectrum of “halos”.

arxiv-2110-15907.title: Learning to Be Cautious
arxiv-2110-15907.creator: Montaser MohammedalamenUniversity of AlbertaEdmonton, Alberta, Canada mohmmeda@ualberta.ca Dustin MorrillSonyAIEdmonton, Alberta, Canada dustin.morrill@sony.com Alexander SieusahaiUniversity of AlbertaEdmonton, Alberta, Canada asieusah@ualberta.ca Yash Satsangi, JPMorgan ChaseLondon, United Kingdom
arxiv-2110-15907.description: Abstract A key challenge in the field of reinforcement learning is to develop agents that behave cautiously in novel situations. It is generally impossible to anticipate all situations that an autonomous system may face or what behavior would best avoid bad outcomes.

arxiv-2207-06801.title: Parameter Synthesis in Markov Models: A Gentle Survey Thanks: This work has been supported by the DFG RTG 2236 “UnRAVeL” and the ERC Advanced Grant 787914 “FRAPPANT”.
arxiv-2207-06801.creator: Nils Jansen, Sebastian Junges and Joost-Pieter Katoen
arxiv-2207-06801.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Nils Jansen, Sebastian Junges and Joost-Pieter Katoen. This paper surveys the analysis of parametric Markov models whose transitions are labelled with functions over a finite set of parameters. These models are symbolic representations of uncountable many concrete probabilistic models, each obtained by instantiating the parameters.

arxiv-2211-16382.title: Orientations of DM Halos in FIRE-2 Milky Way-mass Galaxies
arxiv-2211-16382.creator: Jay Baptista, Robyn Sanderson, Dan Huber, Andrew Wetzel, Omid Sameie, Michael Boylan-Kolchin, Jeremy Bailin, Philip F. Hopkins, Claude-André Faucher-Giguere, Sukanya Chakrabarti, Drona Vargya, Nondh Panithanpaisal, Arpit Arora, Emily Cunningham
arxiv-2211-16382.description: Abstract The shape and orientation of dark matter (DM) halos are sensitive to the micro-physics of the DM particle, yet in many mass models, the symmetry axes of the Milky Way’s DM halo are often assumed to be aligned with the symmetry axes of the stellar disk.

arxiv-2305-03229.title: Tollmien-Schlichting waves in the subsonic regime
arxiv-2305-03229.creator: Nader Masmoudi, Yuxi Wang, Di Wu, Zhifei Zhang
arxiv-2305-03229.description: Abstract . The Tollmien-Schlichting (T-S) waves play a key role in the early stages of boundary layer transition. In a breakthrough work [ 13 ] , Grenier, Guo and Nguyen gave the first rigorous construction of the T-S waves of temporal mode for the incompressible fluid.

arxiv-2308-00412.title: Crystallization dynamics of amorphous yttrium iron garnet thin films
arxiv-2308-00412.creator: Sebastian Sailler, Gregor Skobjin, Heike Schlörb, Benny Boehm, Olav Hellwig, Andy Thomas, Sebastian T. B. Goennenwein, Michaela Lammel
arxiv-2308-00412.description: Abstract Yttrium iron garnet (YIG) is a prototypical material in spintronics due to its exceptional magnetic properties. To exploit these properties high quality thin films need to be manufactured. Deposition techniques like sputter deposition or pulsed laser deposition at ambient temperature produce amorphous films, which need a post annealing step to induce crystallization.

arxiv-2405-08793.title: A Brief Introduction to Causal Inference in Machine Learning
arxiv-2405-08793.creator: Kyunghyun Cho
arxiv-2405-08793.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kyunghyun Cho. PREFACE

This is a lecture note produced for DS-GA 3001.003 “Special Topics in DS - Causal Inference in Machine Learning” at the Center for Data Science, New York University in Spring, 2024. This course was created to target master’s and PhD level students with basic background in machine learning but who were not exposed to causal inference or causal reasoning in general previously.

arxiv-2410-05648.title: Does RoBERTa Perform Better than BERT in Continual Learning: An Attention Sink Perspective
arxiv-2410-05648.creator: Xueying Bai, Yifan Sun, Niranjan Balasubramanian
arxiv-2410-05648.description: Abstract Continual learning (CL) aims to train models that can sequentially learn new tasks without forgetting previous tasks’ knowledge. Although previous works observed that pre-training can benefit CL, it remains unclear whether a pre-trained model with higher downstream capacity also performs better in CL.

arxiv-2502-06520.title: Cancellation of a critical pair in discrete Morse theory and its effect on (co)boundary operators
arxiv-2502-06520.creator: Anupam Mondal, Sajal Mukherjee, Pritam Chandra Pramanik
arxiv-2502-06520.description: Abstract Discrete Morse theory helps us compute the homology groups of simplicial complexes in an efficient manner. A “good” gradient vector field reduces the number of critical simplices, simplifying the homology calculations by reducing them to the computation of homology groups of a simpler chain complex. This homology computation hinges on an efficient enumeration of gradient trajectories.

arxiv-2506-03992.title: Trilinear characterizations of the Fourier extension conjecture on the paraboloid in three dimensions Thanks: Eric Sawyer’s research supported in part by a grant from the National Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada
arxiv-2506-03992.creator: Cristian Rios, Eric Sawyer
arxiv-2506-03992.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Cristian Rios, Eric Sawyer. We first prove that a local trilinear extension inequality on the paraboloid in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} is equivalent to the Fourier restriction conjecture in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} , which may be viewed as a companion result to either the transversal trilinear inequality of Bennett, Carbery and Tao in [ BeCaTa ] , or to the bilinear characterization due to Tao, Vargas and Vega in [ TaVaVe ] .

arxiv-2507-07892.title: Baryonification: An alternative to hydrodynamical simulations for cosmological studies
arxiv-2507-07892.creator: Joop Schaye
arxiv-2507-07892.description: Abstract We present an improved baryonification (BFC) model that modifies dark-matter-only N N -body simulations to generate particle-level outputs for gas, dark matter, and stars. Unlike previous implementations, our approach first splits each simulation particle into separate dark matter and baryonic components, which are then displaced individually using the BFC technique.

britannica-1911-trinidad.title: Trinidad (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-trinidad.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-trinidad.description: Article 'Trinidad' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 27), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of the coast of Venezuela, between 10° 3′ and 10° 50′ N. and 60° 39′, and 62° W. Corozal Point projecting from its north-western and Icacos Point from its south-western extremity enclose the Gulf of Paria.

pmc-10571085.title: Dynamic DNA Networks-Guided Directional and Orthogonal Transient Biocatalytic Cascades
pmc-10571085.creator: Yu Ouyang, Jiantong Dong, Itamar Willner
pmc-10571085.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). DNA frameworks, consisting of constitutional dynamic networks (CDNs) undergoing fuel-driven reconfiguration, are coupled to a dissipative reaction module that triggers the reconfigured CDNs into a transient intermediate CDNs recovering the parent CDN state. Biocatalytic cascades consisting of the glucose oxidase (GOx)/horseradish peroxidase (HRP) couple or the lactate dehydrogenase (LDH)/nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) couple are tethered to the constituents of two different CDNs, allowing the CDNs-guided operation of the spatially confined GOx/HRP or LDH/NAD+ biocatalytic cascades.

pmc-10684798.title: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of kidney in an adult patient with positive family history of rhabdoid tumor: A case report and review of literature
pmc-10684798.creator: Farhood Khaleghi mehr, Nasrollah Abian, Mandana Rahimi, Yasaman Moradi
pmc-10684798.description: Introduction and importanceMalignant rhabdoid tumor of kidney (MRTK) is almost exclusive to children. Only 10 cases of adult MRTK have been reported. Here, we present a case of MRTK in an adult patient and discuss its clinical findings, diagnostic challenges, and treatment outcome. We also perform literature review on this issue.

pmc-11529401.title: Comparison of Arthroscopy-Assisted Reduction Internal Fixation versus Open Reduction Internal of Tibial Plateau Fracture Management: A Systematic Review of Case Control Studies
pmc-11529401.creator: Yudi Mahardika, I Gusti Ngurah Wien Aryana
pmc-11529401.description: Background:Tibial plateau fractures are complex injuries that demand meticulous surgical techniques to achieve anatomical reduction and stable fixation. Both ARIF and ORIF have been utilized for fracture management, each with its advantages and limitations. ARIF offers the potential for enhanced visualization, accurate reduction, and minimally invasive approaches.

pmc-12365134.title: Genomic surveillance in Morocco tracks SARS-CoV-2 variant shift from Alpha to Omicron sublineage JN1
pmc-12365134.creator: Oumaima Bouddahab, Safaa Aqillouch, Hicham Charoute, Rachid Noureddine, Adil El Hamouchi, Oumaima Laazaazia, Achraf Aainouss, Hanâ Baba, Ahd Ouladlahsen, Pascal Pineau, M’hammed Sarih, Abderrahmane Maaroufi, Mustapha Lkhider, Abdelhamid Barakat, Sayeh Ezzikouri
pmc-12365134.description: The persistent evolution of SARS-CoV-2 highlights the crucial role of genomic surveillance in tracking emerging variants and guiding public health interventions. We performed whole-genome sequencing on 235 SARS-CoV-2-positive samples collected across Morocco between 2021 and 2024 to characterize viral evolution and variant dynamics.

pmc-12394167.title: A rare intronic c.2654+1G>A mutation in CSF1R-microglial encephalopathy: a case report
pmc-12394167.creator: HongYan Wu, JingYu Shi, XiaoShan Wang, Mei Yang, Jing Cai
pmc-12394167.description: ObjectiveWe report a case of CSF1R-microglial encephalopathy associated with a rare intronic c.2654 + 1G>A mutation, featuring negative diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) findings and a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) biomarker profile indicative of Alzheimer’s disease-related changes, and we explore the associations between genetic mutations, CSF biomarker alterations, and neuroimaging manifestations.

pmc-12437482.title: Prevalence of autistic traits and their relationships with other psychopathological domains in young adults seeking psychiatric attention: a cluster analysis
pmc-12437482.creator: G Ingrosso, B Demartini, F Serio, V Nisticò, G Broglia, A Bertani, R Faggioli, O Gambini, G Massimetti, L Dell’Osso, B Carpita
pmc-12437482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionNearly two-thirds of individuals with a mental disorder start experiencing symptoms during adolescence or early adulthood, and the onset of a mental disorder during this critical life stage strongly predicts adverse socioeconomic and health outcomes. Subthreshold manifestations of Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD), also called autistic traits, are known to be associated with a higher vulnerability to the development of other psychiatric disorders.

pmc-12561833.title: Correction: Xia and Haas (2025). A Systematic Review on the Association Between Bilingualism and Theory of Mind in Adulthood. Behavioral Sciences, 15(6), 815
pmc-12561833.creator: Rowena J Xia, Brian W Haas
pmc-12561833.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). m and theory of mind has largely focused on children. However, several recent studies of the theory of mind have found differences in theory of mind processing among older populations, namely adults. Given that language has been found to play an important role in the successful theory of the mind task performance of adults, it is valuable to understand the relationship of the language ability of bilingualism and theory of mind in adults.

pmc-12581787.title: Decoding hybrid origins and genetic architecture of leaf traits variation in camellia via high-density 21K SNP array for genomic prediction
pmc-12581787.creator: Jiayu Li, Yixuan Luo, Rui Zhang, Xinchun Li, Hongwei Pan, Hengfu Yin
pmc-12581787.description: The domestication of ornamental plants is primarily driven by aesthetic values and usually involves frequent hybridization events. Camellia spp., a globally famous woody flower, exemplifies the complex origins and extensive phenotypic variation. Here, based on the whole genome resequencing 220 germplasms, we developed Camellia21K, a high-density SNP array enabling cost-effective genome-wide genotyping.

pmc-12696108.title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals probiotic reversal of neonatal morphine-induced gene disruptions underlying adolescent pain hypersensitivity
pmc-12696108.creator: Junyi Tao, Danielle Antoine, Richa Jalodia, Eridania Valdes, Sean Michael Boyles, William Hulme, Sabita Roy
pmc-12696108.description: Neonatal morphine is commonly administered in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) to manage pain. However, its long-term effects on the neurodevelopment of pain pathways remain a significant concern. The midbrain is a core region that plays a central role in pain processing and opioid-mediated analgesia.

pmc-12971612.title: As Critical as the Score in the E‐Sports World: The Effect of Stress on Eating Behavior
pmc-12971612.creator: Ceren Şarahman Kahraman, Cansu Memiç İnan, Nurcan Yabancı Ayhan
pmc-12971612.description: In e‐sports players, the competitive environment and increased time spent in front of the screen for the game may lead to stress and physical inactivity, and individuals may develop negative eating behaviors. In this study, it was aimed to examine the relationship between perceived stress and eating behavior in e‐sports players.

pmc-13431207.title: Intraocular pressure and optic disc cupping in school-aged children: An epidemiological study in Taiwan
pmc-13431207.creator: Hsiao-Lien Chang, Yen-Ching Lin, Yun Hsia, Jehn-Yu Huang, Bo-I Kuo, Tsing-Hong Wang, Chao-Wen Lin, Yao-Lin Liu, Tzu-Hsun Tsai, I-Jong Wang, Chien-Chia Su
pmc-13431207.description: PURPOSE:The purpose of the study was to investigate intraocular pressure (IOP), cup-to-disc ratio (CDR), and ocular biometrics in school-aged children in Taiwan and to evaluate the factors associated with IOP and CDR.MATERIALS AND METHODS:This nationwide school-based study prospectively enrolled children aged 6–18 years.

pmc-13516012.creator: Jingwen Li, Tingru Luo

pmc-13539653.title: Ankh‐Score Produces Better Sequence Alignments Than AlphaFold3
pmc-13539653.creator: Julia Malec, Karina Rusen, G. Brian Golding, Lucian Ilie
pmc-13539653.description: Protein sequence alignment is one of the most fundamental procedures in bioinformatics. Due to its many downstream applications, improvements to this procedure are of great importance. We consider two revolutionary concepts that emerged recently as candidates for improving the state‐of‐the‐art alignment methods: AlphaFold and protein language models such as Ankh, ProtT5, or ESM‐C.

pmc-13544770.title: Mandibular lymph node tuberculosis in an 11-year-old child managed without surgery: a case report
pmc-13544770.creator: Luna Jouda, Mohamad Hamzeh
pmc-13544770.description: Introduction and importance:Tuberculosis (TB) is a chronic infectious disease that can affect multiple anatomical sites. Although involvement of the maxillofacial region is rare, mandibular lymph node TB is particularly uncommon and may pose diagnostic challenges.Case presentation:An 11-year-old male patient presented with a persistent swelling on the right side of the mandible for 8 months.

pmc-13720129.title: Observability of gustatory information in scalp EEG
pmc-13720129.creator: Yifei Zhang, Tianyu Dong, Yunhao Gong, Xinyu Wang, Zhongren Wei, Xianghao Wu, Weijia Li, Hongwei Yu, Jingjing Liu
pmc-13720129.description: Compared with vision and audition, gustation yields weaker and more confound-sensitive scalp (EEG) responses. Here we review gustatory EEG through an observability framework comprising detectability, reproducibility and interpretability. Low-frequency, especially delta-band, activity currently provides the strongest evidence for taste-identity detectability, whereas event-related potentials (ERPs) evidence is stronger for intensity. Spatial and network features remain promising but methodologically constrained.
